citation: Cărare, Thiemann, Morrow, Wales, Pyzer-Knapp & Dicks, "Global properties of the energy landscape: a testing and training arena for machine learned potentials", npj Comput. Mater. (2025), doi:10.1038/s41524-025-01878-x; dataset Landscape17, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.29949230
license: CC BY 4.0 (Landscape17); 坐标逐位照抄，力与能量不随资产发布
system: Azobenzene, C6H5-N=N-C6H5, has two distinct configurations about its N=N bond, cis and trans. The structures below are stationary points of its potential energy surface at omega-B97x/6-31G(d), taken from a published kinetic transition network in which every minimum and every transition state was located and verified by Hessian analysis. You are setting up a transition-state refinement for the pathway in which one nitrogen inverts in the plane of the fragment, and need a starting geometry that already shows that distortion: one C-N=N angle opened towards 180 degrees, and the two C-N bonds no longer equal, because the inverting nitrogen shortens its own C-N bond.
candidate_note: four stationary points of the same published network
objective: 按几何规格从同一网络的四个驻点中选出所需的起始构型；这是推断的逆问题。

constraints.name: opened angle
constraints.text: one of the two C-N=N angles is at least 160 degrees

constraints.name: C-N asymmetry
constraints.text: the two C-N bond lengths differ by at least 0.05 angstrom

notes: C–N=N–C 二面角在某个 C–N=N 角接近 180° 时是病态的：定义其中一个平面的三个原子趋于共线，二面角会在 0° 与 180° 之间跳变，幅度远超已发表坐标的精度。因此分类规则先看角、再看二面角，并在有角张开时直接把二面角判为未定义。
与 azobenzene-ts-0-1（推断题）用同一组结构但反向提问：推断题问"这是什么"，本题问"哪一个满足规格"。
这是按几何目标选构型，不是改变结构的分子设计；是否计为设计题需人工审定。
